title: Saved filters · verify
subtitle: PR #456 · signed in as **demo@example.com** (admin) · seeded with `node scripts/seed-review.mjs`

features.title: Save a filter
features.intro: A user can save the current order filter under a name and see it in the sidebar.
steps: Open the page with the button below. The table shows **12 open orders** (seeded).
Click **Save filter**, type `Open orders`, press Enter.
The sidebar now lists **Open orders** under *Saved filters*.

steps.text: Check that the row was stored. Run this:

copy.label: shell
copy.text: sqlite3 dev.db "SELECT name, query FROM saved_filter ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"

features.pass: The sidebar shows the filter and the newest saved_filter row is 'Open orders | status=open'.

features.title: Reload keeps the filter
features.intro: A saved filter survives a reload and opens the same result set.
steps: The URL becomes `/orders?status=open` and the table shows the same 12 orders.
features.pass: After a reload, the saved filter opens the same 12 orders.

features.title: Assistant creates a filter
features.intro: The in-app assistant can propose a filter. Accepting it must save a complete filter, not only show a preview.

steps.text: Open the assistant and send this prompt:

copy.label: Assistant prompt
copy.text: Save a filter called 'Late orders' for orders that are open and past their due date.

steps: Reload the page and open **Late orders** from the sidebar.
features.pass: After accepting and reloading, 'Late orders' shows exactly the 3 seeded overdue orders.
features.note: Needs an assistant API key in `.env`. Without it, mark this feature blocked.
